premise: Exactly four loading docks are open at the distribution center today.
hypothesis: At least five loading docks are open at the distribution center today.
label: contradiction
notes: Exactly four rules out five or more.

premise: No more than two technicians may enter the clean room at the same time.
hypothesis: Three technicians may enter the clean room together.
label: contradiction
notes: A maximum of two directly conflicts with permitting three at once.

premise: Every refrigerated crate must remain below 5 degrees Celsius while in storage.
hypothesis: Some refrigerated crates may be stored at 8 degrees Celsius.
label: contradiction
notes: The universal temperature limit excludes any refrigerated crate at 8 degrees Celsius.

premise: Only three of the eight elevators are operating in the tower today.
hypothesis: All eight elevators are operating in the tower today.
label: contradiction
notes: Only three operating is incompatible with all eight operating.

premise: Fewer than half of the archived boxes have been digitized.
hypothesis: Most of the archived boxes have been digitized.
label: contradiction
notes: Fewer than half conflicts with more than half.

premise: None of the emergency exits may be blocked during business hours.
hypothesis: At least one emergency exit may be blocked during business hours.
label: contradiction
notes: None allowed directly conflicts with at least one allowed.

premise: Exactly one regional office handles passport renewals for this district.
hypothesis: Two regional offices handle passport renewals for this district.
label: contradiction
notes: Exactly one excludes there being two such offices.

premise: Each delivery route may contain at most twelve stops.
hypothesis: A delivery route with fifteen stops still satisfies the stated limit.
label: contradiction
notes: Fifteen exceeds the maximum of twelve.

premise: All fourteen turbines passed the safety inspection.
hypothesis: Every turbine passed the safety inspection.
label: entailment
notes: All and every express the same universal claim.

premise: Exactly six chairs are reserved for the panel.
hypothesis: At least six chairs are reserved for the panel.
label: entailment
notes: Exactly six necessarily satisfies at least six.

premise: No customer waited more than twenty minutes for service.
hypothesis: Every customer's wait was twenty minutes or less.
label: entailment
notes: The upper-bound statement is preserved.

premise: At least nine sensors triggered during the test.
hypothesis: More than eight sensors triggered during the test.
label: entailment
notes: At least nine is equivalent to more than eight for whole-number sensor counts.

premise: Each of the five satellite offices is open on Fridays.
hypothesis: All five satellite offices are open on Fridays.
label: entailment
notes: Each of the five entails all five.

premise: Only two printers are online in the records room.
hypothesis: No more than two printers are online in the records room.
label: entailment
notes: Exactly two satisfies the upper bound of two.

premise: Sixteen of the twenty field samples passed the purity test.
hypothesis: More than half of the field samples passed the purity test.
label: entailment
notes: Sixteen of twenty is greater than half.

premise: Both backup generators remained online throughout the outage.
hypothesis: Neither backup generator went offline during the outage.
label: entailment
notes: Both remaining online entails that neither went offline.

premise: Between six and nine inspection teams are scheduled to visit the plant this month.
hypothesis: Exactly seven inspection teams are scheduled to visit the plant this month.
label: neutral
notes: A range from six through nine does not determine that the exact count is seven.

premise: No more than twenty applications were approved this morning.
hypothesis: Exactly eighteen applications were approved this morning.
label: neutral
notes: An upper bound of twenty does not determine the exact number approved.

premise: More than thirty seats remain available for the afternoon session.
hypothesis: Exactly thirty-five seats remain available for the afternoon session.
label: neutral
notes: More than thirty does not establish the specific count of thirty-five.

premise: Some warehouse aisles were closed for inventory counting.
hypothesis: Exactly three warehouse aisles were closed for inventory counting.
label: neutral
notes: Some does not determine the exact number closed.

premise: At least one elevator is undergoing maintenance this morning.
hypothesis: Two elevators are undergoing maintenance this morning.
label: neutral
notes: At least one does not determine whether the count is exactly two.

premise: More than half of the applicants submitted a portfolio.
hypothesis: Three quarters of the applicants submitted a portfolio.
label: neutral
notes: More than half does not establish the more specific three-quarters proportion.

premise: At least forty seats are occupied in the auditorium.
hypothesis: Exactly forty seats are occupied in the auditorium.
label: neutral
notes: At least forty allows forty or any larger number.

premise: Fewer than ten delivery vans require servicing this week.
hypothesis: Exactly six delivery vans require servicing this week.
label: neutral
notes: Fewer than ten does not determine that the exact count is six.

premise: Every outbound shipment must pass X-ray screening, and no shipment may bypass screening for any reason.
hypothesis: An outbound shipment may bypass X-ray screening if the logistics director approves it.
label: contradiction
notes: The hypothesis introduces an exception that the premise explicitly rules out.

premise: Remote exam answers must be submitted through the assessment portal; email submissions will not be accepted under any circumstances.
hypothesis: Email submissions are accepted when the assessment portal is unavailable.
label: contradiction
notes: The premise disallows email submissions under all circumstances, so the proposed outage exception conflicts with it.

premise: All laboratory samples must be labeled before storage, and unlabeled samples are never placed in storage.
hypothesis: An unlabeled laboratory sample may be stored temporarily with a supervisor's approval.
label: contradiction
notes: Temporary supervisor approval would create an exception to the stated no-unlabeled-storage rule.

premise: Access badges must never be shared with another person, including a supervisor.
hypothesis: An employee may lend an access badge to a team lead during an emergency.
label: contradiction
notes: The premise explicitly prohibits sharing with any other person, so the emergency exception contradicts it.

premise: No vehicles may enter the pedestrian plaza between 10:00 AM and 4:00 PM, without exception.
hypothesis: A delivery van may enter the pedestrian plaza at noon if security approves the delivery.
label: contradiction
notes: Noon falls inside the prohibited period, and the premise allows no exceptions.

premise: Every invoice must include a purchase-order number; invoices without one are rejected automatically with no exceptions.
hypothesis: The finance director may approve an invoice that has no purchase-order number.
label: contradiction
notes: The proposed director approval conflicts with the explicit no-exceptions rejection rule.

premise: Backup data must never be copied to a personal device.
hypothesis: Backup data may be copied to a personal laptop when the IT manager gives written approval.
label: contradiction
notes: Written approval would create an exception to a rule stated as never permitting personal-device copies.

premise: Every participant must complete identity verification before entering the secure venue, and nobody may enter before verification.
hypothesis: VIP participants may enter the secure venue before identity verification.
label: contradiction
notes: The hypothesis exempts VIPs from a requirement that the premise applies to every participant.

premise: Bicycles are prohibited in the lobby, except folded bicycles enclosed in carrying cases.
hypothesis: A folded bicycle inside a carrying case is permitted in the lobby.
label: entailment
notes: The hypothesis restates the explicit exception.

premise: Only authorized employees may enter the server room, except fire inspectors conducting an official inspection.
hypothesis: Fire inspectors conducting an official inspection may enter the server room.
label: entailment
notes: The stated exception permits fire inspectors to enter during an official inspection.

premise: A parking permit is required on weekdays, except when the weekday is a public holiday.
hypothesis: A parking permit is not required on a weekday that is also a public holiday.
label: entailment
notes: The hypothesis directly restates the public-holiday exception.

premise: Packages weighing more than 20 kilograms require two human handlers, except when the package is moved entirely by a mechanical lift.
hypothesis: A package over 20 kilograms moved entirely by a mechanical lift does not require two human handlers.
label: entailment
notes: The mechanical-lift exception removes the two-handler requirement.

premise: All paper forms must be signed in ink, except forms submitted electronically may use an approved digital signature.
hypothesis: An electronically submitted form may use an approved digital signature.
label: entailment
notes: The hypothesis preserves the stated exception for electronic forms.

premise: Visitors must check in at reception, except couriers who only drop sealed packages at the loading dock.
hypothesis: A courier who only drops a sealed package at the loading dock does not have to check in at reception.
label: entailment
notes: The hypothesis restates the courier exception.

premise: Food and drinks are prohibited in the test laboratory, except sealed drinking water kept at the designated hydration desk.
hypothesis: Sealed drinking water is allowed at the designated hydration desk in the test laboratory.
label: entailment
notes: The hypothesis restates the explicit sealed-water exception.

premise: Employees must work onsite every Tuesday, except employees assigned to an approved field visit that day.
hypothesis: An employee assigned to an approved Tuesday field visit is exempt from the Tuesday onsite requirement.
label: entailment
notes: The hypothesis directly expresses the approved-field-visit exception.

premise: Roof access is prohibited, except for maintenance staff carrying an active work order.
hypothesis: The building manager reviews maintenance work orders every Monday.
label: neutral
notes: The premise does not state when work orders are reviewed.

premise: Only registered vendors may sell goods at the market, except nonprofit groups with a written invitation from the organizer.
hypothesis: Invited nonprofit groups receive free electricity at their booths.
label: neutral
notes: The exception concerns permission to sell, not booth utilities.

premise: Conference rooms require advance reservations, except for emergency response teams handling an active incident.
hypothesis: Emergency response teams always use the largest conference room.
label: neutral
notes: The exception removes the reservation requirement but does not specify which room emergency teams use.

premise: Cash withdrawals require photo identification, except withdrawals authenticated at a biometric kiosk.
hypothesis: The biometric kiosks are located on the second floor.
label: neutral
notes: The premise says nothing about kiosk location.

premise: Protective helmets are required throughout the processing area, except while a worker is inside an enclosed control cabin.
hypothesis: The enclosed control cabins are air-conditioned.
label: neutral
notes: The helmet exception does not establish anything about cabin climate control.

premise: Dogs are not permitted in the office, except trained service animals accompanying a person who needs them.
hypothesis: Service animals in the office must wear blue identification vests.
label: neutral
notes: The premise permits service animals but does not state any vest requirement.

premise: Merchandise returns require a receipt, except defective products whose serial numbers can be verified in the warranty database.
hypothesis: Serial-number verification usually takes about ten minutes.
label: neutral
notes: The exception establishes when a receipt is unnecessary, not how long verification takes.

premise: Employees must use the corporate VPN for remote access, except devices connected directly to the secure laboratory network.
hypothesis: The secure laboratory network is faster than the corporate VPN.
label: neutral
notes: The premise gives an access exception but makes no speed comparison.
